 The Toronto Raptors hosted the Orlando Magic at Scotiabank Arena on Wednesday, with Scottie Barnes eager to bounce back after a three-day rest.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Barnes went scoreless in the Raptors' loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves on Sunday. He stated that he should be better and "try to dominate."
 He was not kidding.
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 In the third quarter against the Magic, he received an outlet pass from RJ Barrett and finished it off with a 360 dunk , much to the delight of the home crowd.
 The Raptors need the 25-year-old Barnes to be consistent and carry a heavy load, with Kawhi Leonard out indefinitely due to a knee injury . Barnes has proven that he can put Toronto on his back, and he might have to do it again.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Entering the game against the Magic, he was averaging 17.0 points, 7.7 rebounds, 4.3 assists, and 2.0 steals in 30.3 minutes. His numbers are expected to increase amid Leonard's latest setback, especially his scoring.
 The two-time All-Star, however, is more proud of his defense.
 "I know I'm one of the best defensive players in the world, you know? I do what I do, and I make an impact on that floor every single night," said Barnes in a report from The Canadian Press' John Chidley-Hill.
 Click Here to Subscribe He added that his goal is to earn his first nod to the All-Defensive Team.
 As of this writing, the Raptors lead the Magic by a sizable margin in the fourth quarter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Barnes has 26 points, six rebounds, four assists, and three steals, while Barrett has 24 points, seven rebounds, and five assists.
